$schema_note: Navigation index for the Dockyrd UI design export. Line numbers are 1-based and refer to the files as published (project/<file>). Every page is a self-contained .dc.html with inline styles; use `search_anchors` strings if line numbers drift.

project.name: Dockyrd
project.description: Open-source, self-hosted deployment platform; lean, reliable, safe alternative to Coolify. Positioning: the Sevalla experience on your own hardware, without Coolify complexity.

format.artboard_files: project/*.dc.html, one per artboard; each is a "Design Component".

dc_syntax.head_assets: <helmet> contains font <link> and a tiny <style> (hover rules for .nav, .btn-primary, .btn-outline, .row, .name)
dc_syntax.logic: <script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script data-props='{"$preview":{"width":1360,"height":N}}'> class Component extends DCLogic { constructor(props){super(props);this.state={...}} renderVals(){ return {...bindings} } }

conventions: All styling is inline style="" attributes (no CSS classes except the hover helpers).
Artboards are fluid (expand: fill), width 1360 preview, flex-wrap layouts.
No <sc-for> inside <svg> or <table>; charts bind attributes like d="{{path}}"; tables are div role="table".
Sample data is consistent across pages (see sample_data).

design_tokens.hero_gradient: radial-gradient(circle at 85% 15%, rgba(214,150,230,.55), transparent 45%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 95%, rgba(255,160,190,.4), transparent 40%), linear-gradient(120deg,#2F4A8A,#4767BC 55%,#7088DA)

typography.mono_labels: Geist Mono 11-12px, uppercase, letter-spacing .06em (chips, pills, field labels, stat labels)

logo.sidebar_light: inline SVG wordmark, width 150, aria-label="Dockyrd", inside <a aria-label="Dockyrd home"> in the sidebar
logo.auth_dark: white wordmark, width 170, in the gradient panel of SignIn/ForgotPassword

sidebar.files: all pages except SignIn and ForgotPassword (Settings uses a variant)
structure: div role="group" aria-label="Project sections": Applications, Databases, Static sites, Object storage (full menu items, margin-bottom 28px)
mono label "Server" then Analytics (href Server.dc.html), Security (/server/security), and Terminal
server health card at bottom (green dot, v0.1.0 chip)
Personal: Profile & security (active), Notifications, API tokens
Instance: General, Team, Git providers, Backup storage, Updates

top_header.content: breadcrumb nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" left; right: search trigger link (aria-label="Search pages, resources and actions", href Search.dc.html, shows ⌘K) + secondary button "Docs".
top_header.note: The "Add service" header button was removed everywhere.

buttons.primary: background #0B1F3A, white mono uppercase text, class btn-primary
buttons.secondary: transparent, border 1.5px solid #CBD0D8, navy mono uppercase text, class btn-outline

shared_blocks.stat_tile: white card radius 20, mono uppercase label, 40px/600 number, 13px muted sub-text
shared_blocks.list_row: class "row", border-top 1px #ECEAE6, icon tile 40px #E3F0FF, name link class "name", status pill, mono url, sha chip + message right-aligned
shared_blocks.tabs: role="tablist" buttons with 2px bottom border (active navy); state.tab drives sc-if panels
shared_blocks.switch: button role="switch" aria-checked; state keys auto/lfs/tf

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.desc: Home overview: greeting, 4 stat tiles (Applications 9, Databases 5, Static sites 2, Domains 7), attention bar, recently updated, latest deployments, server usage chart (cpu/mem SVG built in renderVals via line()), backups.

pages.name: Projects
pages.desc: Projects list. Banner with dismiss, gradient hero with quick-add card (state kind = app|db|site), server strip, project card grid, recent activity.

headings.text: Deploy to your own servers. Without the mess.

pages.name: Project overview (Client X)
pages.desc: One project: header, tabs Services / Project settings, service cards, dashed Add-service card. Production/Staging switcher was removed; state.env stays "production".

pages.name: Analytics
pages.desc: NOTE file name is Server.dc.html but the page is titled Analytics (renamed from Server). Server monitoring: range pills, 4 sparkline tiles, Important events feed with filter chips, Needs attention, Docker cleanup, running containers table (div role=table).

pages.name: Applications
pages.desc: Overview of all 9 applications: 4 summary tiles, filter input (state q), list rows linking to Project.dc.html.

pages.name: Databases
pages.desc: Overview of 5 databases (4 Postgres, 1 Redis) with engine chip, size, backup info.

pages.name: Static sites
pages.desc: Overview of 2 static sites (marketing, docs) linking to StaticSiteDetail.dc.html, plus dashed Create static site row.

pages.name: Object storage
pages.desc: Empty state: 0 buckets, gradient hero, Garage and MinIO install cards.

pages.desc: Detail page for static site "marketing" (Client X). 7 tabs controlled by state.tab: Overview, Deployments, Logs, Analytics, Environment, Domains, Settings. Networking merged into Domains. This is the master file of the 7 StaticSite* boards.

pages.name: Sign in
pages.desc: Split layout, gradient brand panel left (dark logo), form right: email, password with Show/Hide, Forgot password link, GitHub button. Submit shows error state (state.err).

pages.name: Forgot password
pages.desc: Same split layout. Form state -> success state "Check your inbox" (state.sent). Includes CLI hint `dockyrd reset-password`.

pages.desc: Settings page with a different sidebar (back link + Personal group + Instance group). Content (max 880px, centered): Profile, Password, Two-factor switch, Active sessions.

pages.desc: Active search state: blurred dashboard background + centered palette (groups Pages, Resources, Actions; filter by typing; ArrowUp/Down/Enter). The header search trigger on every sidebar page links here.

how_to_find.change_sidebar_everywhere: Edit the <aside> block in each file (same markup, only the active item differs).
how_to_find.change_button_style: Search for "btn-primary" / "btn-outline" and the shared inline style strings; there is no shared stylesheet.
how_to_find.static_site_tabs: StaticSiteDetail.dc.html: tab panels are <sc-if value="{{isOverview|isDeployments|isLogs|isAnalytics|isEnv|isDomains|isSettings}}"> blocks; data (deploys, logs, vars, chart paths) is built in renderVals().
how_to_find.search_palette: Search.dc.html: role="dialog" aria-label="Search"; item data + filtering in renderVals() (groups Pages/Resources/Actions).
how_to_find.canvas_layout: project/canvas.json: rows y=0 (Dashboard, Projects, Project, Analytics), y=1740 (Applications, Databases, Static sites, Object storage), y=3040 (Static site Overview), y=4780/6420 (other static site tabs), y=8060 (Sign in, Forgot password, Settings, Search).
